integrity: All-size proof uses an exhaustive 49-palette state graph and onto-color counts; finite microscopic verification is supporting evidence, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Three-color threshold-one synchronous updates on labelled complete bipartite graphs only; original CCA biclique census and qualitative general synchronization criterion are prior work; historical equivalence remains possible; no independent audit or validation.
title: Matched eventual periods but different transient clocks for three-state excitable dynamics on bicliques
